_readme.subset: SHA3-256 mode only, both groups of the 1.0 corpus: one with predResistance=true (tgId 9), one with predResistance=false (tgId 20). The returnedBits from expectedResults.json has been inlined into each test alongside the inputs from prompt.json to make this file self-contained.
_readme.invariants: Every group is derFunc=false and reSeed=true. All hex strings are big-endian byte strings whose length in bits matches the corresponding *Len field on the group.

format.revision: const "1.0" (ACVP protocol revision, not the DRBG spec version).
format.TestGroup.tgId: opaque NIST-assigned group id; carried for traceability, not consumed.
format.TestGroup.derFunc: whether Hash_df is used; always false in the subset that ships (SP 800-90A §10.1.1.1 mandates Hash_df for Hash_DRBG so this field is only meaningful for the DRBGs that make it optional).
format.TestGroup.reSeed: whether a reSeed step may appear in otherInput; always true here.
format.TestGroup.predResistance: true → each generate is preceded by a fresh reseed with the provided entropy (SP 800-90A §9.3.1).
format.TestGroup.entropyInputLen: bit length of the instantiate-time entropyInput, and of every per-step entropyInput in otherInput.
format.TestGroup.nonceLen: bit length of the instantiate-time nonce.
format.TestGroup.persoStringLen: bit length of the instantiate-time persoString (may be 0).
format.TestGroup.additionalInputLen: bit length of each otherInput[i].additionalInput (may be 0).
format.TestGroup.returnedBitsLen: bit length of the final expected output (returnedBits) — 4096 in this subset.
format.TestGroup.mode: hash flavor, always "SHA3-256" in this file.
format.TestCase.tcId: opaque NIST-assigned test id; carried for assertion messages.
format.TestCase.otherInput: ordered array of Step objects to run after instantiate. Order is significant — some cases interleave reSeed and generate.
format.TestCase.returnedBits: hex, expected output from the final generate call (length matches returnedBitsLen).
format.Step.additionalInput: hex, additional_input for this step (may be empty).
format.Step.entropyInput: hex, entropy for this step. Present when intendedUse == "reSeed", and also when predResistance is true and intendedUse == "generate" (that generate is preceded by an implicit reseed against this entropy per SP 800-90A §9.3.1).

_readme.parsing: See src/drbg/tests.rs::acvp_hashdrbg_sha3_256 — a single #[test] that walks every group and case, instantiates a HashDrbgSha3_256 with (entropyInput, nonce, persoString), then executes each otherInput step: reSeed steps call HashDrbg::reseed; generate steps call HashDrbg::generate_with_additional_input, with an implicit reseed on the predResistance branch. The final generate must produce exactly TestCase.returnedBits.
_readme.modifications: Vectors are byte-for-byte from upstream except for (a) restriction to SHA3-256 groups, (b) inlining returnedBits into each test case from expectedResults.json, and (c) this _readme field (ignored by serde because none of the Deserialize structs in the harness deny unknown fields).
_readme.howToUpdate: To refresh from upstream: fetch gen-val/json-files/hashDRBG-1.0/prompt.json and expectedResults.json from usnistgov/ACVP-Server, filter testGroups[] to mode=="SHA3-256", copy each test's returnedBits from expectedResults into the matching tcId in prompt, keep this _readme field, and drop any groups whose derFunc or reSeed differ from the invariants above.
